svg.desc: The interview loop as a sequence of rounds: phone screen, two coding rounds, ML coding, ML system design, ML depth, behavioural, then the debrief. Each round lists the signals it mainly scores. The overall score is a weighted mean of round means, and each signal is also averaged across the rounds that score it.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seven rounds, each scored 1–4 on a few signals; the debrief looks for recurring patterns.
